adversarial_task_8_customer_token_plaint.heal_id: J2-HEAL-03 (Phase J-ADV-7 HC-003 P0 + Phase J-ADV-1 ADV1-V01 P1)
vector_pre_heal: HC-003 P0: customer_token built with hash('sha256', userId.|.time().|.APP_KEY) substr(0,32) — no HMAC, second-resolution timestamp → predictable enumeration window + truncated to 128 bits

ADV1-V01 P1: LOYALTY_QR_ACCEPT_LEGACY_PLAINTEXT defaulted to TRUE → attacker with 8-char loyalty_code could POST raw 'FK:<code>' and harvest customer_token + display_name + loyalty_balance_points (PII leak)
fix: HMAC: hash_hmac('sha256', payload_with_bin2hex(random_bytes(16)), config('loyalty.qr.secret') ?: APP_KEY) — full 256-bit (64 hex chars) + 'lt_' prefix
Default flip: config/loyalty.php accept_legacy_plaintext defaults to FALSE; env LOYALTY_QR_ACCEPT_LEGACY_PLAINTEXT=true still allows explicit opt-in (migration escape hatch)
adversarial_task_8_customer_token_plaint.verdict: PASS — J2-HEAL-03 closed (P0 + P1) with HMAC entropy + default flip + 4-test sentinel lock.

adversarial_task_9_user_id_1_super_admin.vector_pre_heal: app/Models/User.php had static::updating(function($user) { if ($user->id === 1) { $user->status = Status::ACTIVE; } }) — on every save of user id=1 the hook forced status back to ACTIVE. Compromised id=1 credentials remained usable after disablement attempt. Insider attack OR account-takeover persistence vector + denial-of-recovery.
adversarial_task_9_user_id_1_super_admin.fix: app/Models/User.php:138-140 — static::updating(function($user) { /* intentionally empty */ }) with explicit comment block lines 124-137 documenting the removal rationale.
adversarial_task_9_user_id_1_super_admin.code_evidence_lines_124_140: Removed hardcoded id===1 fast-path. No automatic status mutation in model lifecycle. Recovery from accidental root lockout handled out-of-band via documented procedure + dedicated seed migration.

test_user_model_has_no_hardcoded_id_one_fast_path — regex grep on User.php source for $user->id === 1 / $user->id == 1 patterns
adversarial_task_9_user_id_1_super_admin.verdict: PASS — J2-HEAL-01 closed (id===1 back-door removed + 3-test sentinel locks both runtime behaviour AND source-string regression).

defense_1_BranchScope_global.note_console_skip: BranchScope::apply skips when App::runningInConsole() && !App::runningUnitTests() — explicit by-design exception for artisan / queue workers. HTTP request path always applies scope (or feature-test path under runningUnitTests).

defense_2_controller_explicit_check.note: Defense-in-depth — BranchScope already filtered the query in 99% of cases, but for endpoints accepting an explicit {order} route binding the explicit branch check is fail-safe.

adversarial_task_10_cross_branch_RBAC_by.tinker_console_exploration_caveat: Direct console tinker tests showed Order::find(1) returns the order even when faking a branch=999 user — BUT this is BY DESIGN (App::runningInConsole() && !App::runningUnitTests() → scope no-op). The HTTP request path under PHP-FPM serving /api/admin/pos-order/{order} DOES apply the scope. Verified indirectly via BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest GREEN + KioskTokenAdminBlockSentinelTest GREEN (both exercise the HTTP path via $this->getJson).
adversarial_task_10_cross_branch_RBAC_by.verdict: PASS — No bypass found. 20-model coverage sentinel green + explicit controller checks present on highest-blast endpoints (refund, cancel, status-change).

adversarial_task_11_owner_impact_if_RBAC.scenario_if_pos_refund_perm_granted_to_p: Any cashier could issue NF525 counter-entry refund → high mass-refund fraud vector (cashier creates fake refund to pocket cash). Mitigation: explicit grant only to Admin + Branch Manager + PosOrderController:58-62 fail-fast can() check + cross-branch denial line 70-73 + DB UNIQUE(parent_order_id) at line 102-108 (prevents double mirror).
adversarial_task_11_owner_impact_if_RBAC.scenario_if_settings_or_roles_create_gra: Cashier could mutate Spatie role assignments → privilege escalation. Mitigation: PermissionRequest::authorize() now calls can('settings') (FormRequest sentinel BUILD-6 refactor). Routes also gated by permission:settings middleware.
adversarial_task_11_owner_impact_if_RBAC.scenario_if_kiosk_token_admin_route_allo: Kiosk borne token (stored in localStorage, physical-access risk) would inherit ALL admin Spatie permissions via the bound admin user. Full /api/admin/* access from a publicly-located kiosk. Mitigation: BlockKioskTokenFromAdminRoutes middleware on both /api/admin/* prefix groups + KioskTokenAdminBlockSentinelTest baseline-lock.
adversarial_task_11_owner_impact_if_RBAC.scenario_if_super_admin_id_1_back_door_r: Compromised id=1 credentials become un-disablable + denial-of-recovery for legitimate ops. Mitigation: UserSuperAdminDisableHardenedSentinel locks both runtime + source-string patterns.
adversarial_task_11_owner_impact_if_RBAC.scenario_if_customer_token_truncated_to_: Token enumeration via predictable timestamp → loyalty_code → token chain → PII leak (display_name + balance). Mitigation: CustomerTokenHmacHardenedSentinelTest locks 1000-token uniqueness + lt_<64hex> format + accept_legacy_plaintext=false default.
